question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：约旦 vs 阿根廷（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Jordan vs Argentina (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: 435 分 Elo 差距令卫冕冠军阿根廷占绝对优势，但末轮轮换动机与梅西腿筋隐忧给约旦留下小幅逼平空间。
one_liner_en: A 435-point Elo gap makes defending champions Argentina overwhelming favourites, though Matchday-3 rotation incentives and Messi's hamstring concern leave Jordan a modest draw window.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：阿根廷 2115（世界第 2）对约旦 1680（第 52），Davidson 模型基线给阿根廷 78% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Argentina 2115 (rank 2) vs Jordan 1680 (rank 52); the Davidson baseline gives Argentina 78%.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮轮换风险：阿根廷先打阿尔及利亚与奥地利，大概率提前出线，第 3 轮主力轮换概率不低。
key_reasons.en: Matchday-3 rotation risk: Argentina face Algeria and Austria first and will likely have qualification settled, making rotation plausible.

key_reasons.cn: 梅西 5 月 25 日左腿筋“肌肉过载”，斯卡洛尼称恢复顺利但 38 岁高龄下末轮出场时间存疑。
key_reasons.en: Messi suffered a left-hamstring 'muscular overload' on May 25; Scaloni says recovery is on track, but his Matchday-3 minutes at 38 are uncertain.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo (fetched 2026-06-11) through a Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat Jordan 6.4% / Draw 15.6% / Argentina 78.0%; bounded evidence adjustment of 6pp total (cap 8pp) for rotation incentive, Messi/fringe injuries, Jordan motivation and indoor venue yields p_final. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
